import copy
import unittest
from solution import completed_paid_totals


class TestPipeline(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_filters_and_accumulates(self):
        orders = [
            {'customer': 'a', 'status': 'completed', 'paid': True, 'total': 4},
            {'customer': 'a', 'status': 'completed', 'paid': True, 'total': 3},
            {'customer': 'b', 'status': 'pending', 'paid': True, 'total': 9},
            {'customer': 'b', 'status': 'completed', 'paid': False, 'total': 8},
        ]
        original = copy.deepcopy(orders)
        self.assertEqual(completed_paid_totals(orders), {'a': 7})
        self.assertEqual(orders, original)

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(completed_paid_totals([]), {})


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
